name: table-tennis-ireland
description: Multi-club table tennis platform and club website monorepo

scripts.build:club: node scripts/check-client-env.mjs club-web --require-live && npm run build --workspace @tti/club-web
scripts.build:platform: node scripts/check-client-env.mjs platform --require-live && npm run build --workspace @tti/platform
scripts.deploy:platform: npm run build:platform && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.platform.jsonc
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run prepare:functions && npx supabase functions deploy club-api club-jobs club-public --use-api
scripts.deploy:club: npm run build:club && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.club-web.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:setup && npm run build
scripts.test:edge: npm run prepare:functions && npx --yes deno@2 check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/club-api/index.ts supabase/functions/club-jobs/index.ts supabase/functions/club-public/index.ts && npx --yes deno@2 test --config supabase/functions/deno.json --allow-env --allow-net supabase/functions/runtime.integration.test.ts supabase/functions/jobs.integration.test.ts supabase/functions/public.integration.test.ts
